John Deaton

Republican candidate for Senator in Congress, Massachusetts · Challenger

Attorney

John Deaton is an attorney and the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate in Massachusetts in 2026. He was also the Republican nominee in 2024 and lost to Sen. Elizabeth Warren. He declared his 2026 candidacy in November 2025, ran unopposed in the September 1, 2026 Republican primary, and faces incumbent Democrat Ed Markey in the general election.

Where Deaton stands

Health care
Opposes Medicare for All. He says it cannot pass because most Senate Democrats do not support it, and he favors breaking up large health insurance companies instead.
Immigration enforcement
Says ICE should be reformed rather than abolished.
Tariffs
Disagrees with President Trump on tariffs.
War with Iran
Disagrees with President Trump on the war with Iran.
Party loyalty
Says he has never voted for Donald Trump and has no loyalty to a political party.

Background

  • Attorney
